d: A hospital admits a registered nurse who becomes a patient herself.
A Florida woman is arrested after taking off from a traffic stop and abandoning her car.
Successful lobbyist Jack Abramoff uses illegal tactics  the chairman of a major company is charged with accounting fraud worth $41 trillion.
A rogue broker's unauthorized speculative trading causes Barings Bank to collapse  Tour de France winner Lance Armstrong is accused of doping.
A marriage plagued by affairs and resentment ends in a gruesome murder  a digitally orchestrated heist drains banks of nearly $45 million globally within a few hours.
Hours after robbing a bank, a teen culprit brags about it on YouTube  a promising biopharmaceutical company becomes a stock market predator.
A billionaire is arrested for insider trading  "The Wolf of Wall Street" defrauds more than 1,500 clients.
A troubled Royal Canadian Mountie officer kills one of his own  the son of a Las Vegas judge robs $1.5 million from a casino.
A website posts explicit photos without the subjects' permission, then demands payment to remove them  El Chapo runs one of the world's largest drug-trafficking organizations.
The ruler of a drug cartel is responsible for mass murders and billions of dollars in drug trafficking  one of the longest-serving U.S. mayors is accused of running a criminal enterprise.
Actress Alexandra Ducsay is murdered in her home  the downfall of a prominent pro-independence leader in Taiwan.
